name: Triangle: Post Pass
idea: The wing passes into the post, then teammates cut so the post player has someone to pass to.
why: When the wing, the post and the hoop are in a straight line, the post defender has to stay behind, so the pass inside is safe. Then the cuts keep the other defenders too busy to help.
tryit: Post: stand on the high side of the block, in a straight line between the wing and the hoop. Cutters: cut hard and never jog. A lazy cut lets your defender help.

frames.say: From the triangle, {2} looks inside first. {2}, {5} and the hoop are in a straight line, so {X5} is stuck behind {5}.
{1} cuts along the baseline to the other side, and {X1} has to chase.
{2} cuts over the top of {5} and sets a *screen* on {X4}.
{4} runs around the screen to the free-throw line. {X4} is stuck!
{5} passes out to {4}, wide open at the free-throw line.
{4} makes the jump shot! In the triangle, every pass starts cuts that get someone open.
